fields.Name: T148 - MCP Add Connection Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the inline connection dialog (createConnection → ShowConnectionDialog) with its server-lookup dropdown and bearer-token field — a distinct dialog from the server dialog and from generic entity forms.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT Ctrl+K), open the MCP section, then go to the Connections tab. Click 'Add Connection' (or 'Add Your First Connection' in the empty state) to open the Add Connection dialog. Confirm the dialog renders with a Server dropdown (populated from configured MCP servers, or empty if none exist), a Name field, a Bearer Token field, and a Status dropdown, plus Create and Cancel actions. Seeing the Add Connection dialog render with these fields is success — you do NOT need to actually create a connection. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Add Connection dialog opens with a Server selector, Name, Bearer Token, and Status fields
The dialog shows Create and Cancel buttons and can be dismissed
The Server dropdown lists configured servers (or shows only the '— select server —' placeholder if none exist)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
